Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://tanstack.com/start/latest/docs/framework/solid/tutorial/fetching-external-api

Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for query/router/table docs agents need: fetching external api

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:

Rules:
